correctness.rationale: Only the difference of the average and the equal-weight composition operator descends to the real Lipschitz quotient. Compact Kantorovich–Rubinstein duality, with commuting suprema, gives the maximum pointwise W₁. For odd m, the fractions allocated from one fiber site sum, when scaled by m, to a half-integer. Subadditivity of distance to the integer lattice and antipodal separation one force cost at least 1/(2m) at every base point. For even m the extreme points of the balanced allocation polytope are integral (two fractional coordinates could be perturbed in opposite directions). Two different assignments differ at at least two labels, so their summed unnormalized costs are at least two. Thus an error below 1/m at every point would select a unique locally continuous assignment and give a section of a degree-two circle map, impossible by degree. The odd construction maintains balanced stationary atoms except for one traveling atom, whose two distances sum to one; the even construction moves a pair together with cost at most 2 min(s,1-s)/m. Closure follows from each relative coordinate changing by -1 in a loop of length one. These prove attained optima for every m≥1, under the stated circumference, equal-weight and continuity conditions.
